description: This file contains utility functions for loading and parsing various Excel and text files related to roles, competencies, and role adjacency data in a career-pathway navigation project. It provides methods for reading and transforming data stored in different formats into structured dataframes or dictionaries, supporting the core functionality of the backend for role and competency mapping.

methods.name: str _safe_read_text(path: Union[str, Path])
methods.description: Reads a text file with encoding fallbacks to handle different encodings and errors.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame load_competency_mapping_excel(xlsx_path: Union[str, Path])
methods.description: Loads a competency mapping Excel file and converts it into a long-form DataFrame with 'competency', 'role', and 'level_raw' columns.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame load_role_adjacency_excel( xlsx_paths: Iterable[Union[str, Path]] )
methods.description: Loads one or more role adjacency Excel files, supporting matrix and long formats, returning a standardized DataFrame with 'source_role', 'target_role', and 'score_raw'.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] load_role_card_texts(paths: Iterable[Union[str, Path]])
methods.description: Parses role card text files into structured role dictionaries including name, description, and category based on heuristics.

methods.name: pd.DataFrame load_role_navigator_excel(xlsx_path: Union[str, Path])
methods.description: Loads the Role Navigator Excel worksheet, returning the raw dataframe for further transformation.
